title: Timeouts and cascading failures

kcs.statement: Every remote call needs a timeout; without one, a hung dependency holds threads or connections until the caller's pool is exhausted and the failure cascades upstream.
Set a call's timeout from the dependency's tail latency (a little above its p99) and below the caller's own deadline, so the caller still has time to respond or fall back.

problem_ideas: 200 threads, a dependency hangs, 50 req/s arrive: how many seconds until the pool is exhausted?
A dependency's p99 is 120 ms; the API deadline is 500 ms with 3 downstream calls in sequence. Set timeouts.
